build_DeepseekV4SWACache: build a DeepseekV4SWACache instance with head_dim, window_size, dtype, and cache_config for sliding window attention
build_DeepseekSparseSWABackend: build a DeepseekSparseSWABackend to get the preferred block size, supported head sizes, and metadata builder class
create_DeepseekSparseSWAMetadataBuilder: create a DeepseekSparseSWAMetadataBuilder and call build to produce metadata for mixed decode and prefill batches
run_compute_swa_indices_kernel: run the Triton kernel to compute sliding window attention indices and lengths for decode tokens in a batch
run_compute_prefill_metadata_kernel: run the Triton kernel to compute prefill gather lengths from sequence lengths and query start locations
